# Operator flags

Every command-line flag of the operator (the manager binary built from cmd/main.go), with its type, default and description. Generated from the binary's --help output.

<!-- generated by `make docs-reference`; do not edit -->

Each flag `--some-name` can also be set with the environment variable `PROTEM_SOME_NAME`: `PROTEM_` followed by the flag name in upper case with dashes replaced by underscores. A flag given on the command line takes precedence over its environment variable.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--agent-image` | string | `"ghcr.io/illeniumstudios/protem-agent:latest"` | The agent image the UI's install files use |
| `--agent-manifests` | string | `"https://github.com/iLLeniumStudios/protem//config/agent/spoke?ref=main"` | The kustomize location of the agent manifests the UI's install files use |
| `--api-bind-address` | string | `":8080"` | The address the Protem web UI & REST API server binds to. |
| `--dev-auth` | bool |  | Enable development personas via X-Test-User (refuses to start unless bound to loopback) |
| `--enable-http2` | bool |  | If set, HTTP/2 will be enabled for the metrics and webhook servers |
| `--health-probe-bind-address` | string | `":8081"` | The address the probe endpoint binds to. |
| `--history-retention` | duration |  | Delete finished requests, and their grants, this long after their last audit event. 0 keeps them forever; otherwise at least 1m. |
| `--hub-api-url` | string |  | The hub's Kubernetes API URL as agents on target clusters reach it; required to connect agents from the UI |
| `--hub-cluster-name` | string | `"local"` | Cluster name of the hub in the fleet |
| `--join-token-ttl` | duration | `15m0s` | How long a join token issued in the UI works, from 10m to 1h |
| `--kubeconfig` | string |  | Paths to a kubeconfig. Only required if out-of-cluster. |
| `--leader-elect` | bool |  | Enable leader election for controller manager. Enabling this will ensure there is only one active controller manager. |
| `--metrics-bind-address` | string | `"0"` | The address the metrics endpoint binds to. Use :8443 for HTTPS or :8080 for HTTP, or leave as 0 to disable the metrics service. |
| `--metrics-cert-key` | string | `"tls.key"` | The name of the metrics server key file. |
| `--metrics-cert-name` | string | `"tls.crt"` | The name of the metrics server certificate file. |
| `--metrics-cert-path` | string |  | The directory that contains the metrics server certificate. |
| `--metrics-secure` | bool | `true` | If set, the metrics endpoint is served securely via HTTPS. Use --metrics-secure=false to use HTTP instead. |
| `--oidc-client-id` | string |  | OIDC Client ID (e.g. protem) |
| `--oidc-issuer-url` | string |  | OIDC Issuer URL (e.g. http://localhost:8085/realms/protem) |
| `--sign-out-url` | string |  | URL the UI opens to sign out (e.g. /oauth2/sign_out); empty hides the link |
| `--subject-template` | string | `"{{.Email}}"` | Template for mapping user to RBAC subject (e.g. {{.Email}} or oidc:{{.Email}}) |
| `--ui-management` | string | `"readonly"` | readonly, or enabled to let the UI create, edit and delete AccessProfiles and add, edit and remove TargetClusters (requires config/rbac/ui_management_role.yaml) |
| `--webhook-cert-key` | string | `"tls.key"` | The name of the webhook key file. |
| `--webhook-cert-name` | string | `"tls.crt"` | The name of the webhook certificate file. |
| `--webhook-cert-path` | string |  | The directory that contains the webhook certificate. |
| `--zap-devel` | bool | `true` | Development Mode defaults(encoder=consoleEncoder,logLevel=Debug,stackTraceLevel=Warn). Production Mode defaults(encoder=jsonEncoder,logLevel=Info,stackTraceLevel=Error) |
| `--zap-encoder` | value |  | Zap log encoding (one of 'json' or 'console') |
| `--zap-log-level` | value |  | Zap Level to configure the verbosity of logging. Can be one of 'debug', 'info', 'error', 'panic'or any integer value > 0 which corresponds to custom debug levels of increasing verbosity |
| `--zap-stacktrace-level` | value |  | Zap Level at and above which stacktraces are captured (one of 'info', 'error', 'panic'). |
| `--zap-time-encoding` | value |  | Zap time encoding (one of 'epoch', 'millis', 'nano', 'iso8601', 'rfc3339' or 'rfc3339nano'). Defaults to 'epoch'. |
